summary: An on/off switch for a setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps external <label for> from naming the inner input. Names the setting and never changes with the state.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the setting.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and sets a customError validity (SB-0009).

value.note: Submitted with the form while on; nothing is submitted while off (like a native checkbox).

checked.note: Current state (on). Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on (valueMissing while off). Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not submitted. A <fieldset disabled> ancestor disables it too without touching this attribute.

size.note: Track and thumb size: default 32x20px track with a 16px thumb, sm 24x16px track with a 12px thumb. The label row keeps the same type size.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: the switch in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Track wrapper; positions the thumb over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> drawn as the track; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Round knob, pointer-events none; at the start while off, slides to the end while on (mirrored in rtl).

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl). FormData read in the listener already has the new value.

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring outside the track (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with the primary color and the thumb moves to the end; position, not color alone, carries the state.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor (:disabled)

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl mixins (ElementInternals): setFormValue(value) only while on, validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing, error -> customError), formResetCallback restores the default checked state from the attribute, formStateRestoreCallback restores the saved state, a disabled host or <fieldset disabled> ancestor is not submitted, <label for> on the host toggles it.

accessibility.targetSize: Track 32x20px (default) or 24x16px (sm); the label next to it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color around the track.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty (NativeControl).

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009); does not toggle

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox; its on/off state is exposed from the native checked state (never a hand-set aria-checked)
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A single setting that is either on or off
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label naming the setting

useCases.when: The consequence of turning it on needs explaining
A compact settings list or a dense toolbar row
A settings form submitted together with other fields
useCases.use: name (and value if "on" is not what the server expects)

antiPatterns.pattern: Changing the label with the state ("On" / "Off")
antiPatterns.why: The label names the setting; the switch already exposes its state (WAI-ARIA APG switch pattern)
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label that names the setting

antiPatterns.pattern: Recording an agreement or choosing several options from a list
antiPatterns.why: Those record a choice rather than set something on or off
The label is the only name for the switch
antiPatterns.alternative: A label that states the setting

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field and Label parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside

drift.contract: thumb is color.background in both states and both modes
drift.realization: shadcn's dark mode uses foreground (off) and primary-foreground (on); one token keeps 3:1 against both tracks in both modes
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.recommendation: Yes: APG switch pattern on a native checkbox, label row beside the track like Checkbox.
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern (role=switch on a native checkbox), label row beside the track, sizes from the visual reference.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.recommendation: No, as in Checkbox: the attribute is the reset default.
openQuestions.answer: No. The checked attribute is the default that form reset restores (like native defaultChecked); checked is a property.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch (APG lists it as optional) or submit the form?
openQuestions.recommendation: Submit the form, like Checkbox and Input (SB-0009); Space toggles.
openQuestions.answer: Enter submits the form through requestSubmit() and does not toggle; Space toggles. Matches native checkbox behavior and every other form control here.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes, and under which names?
openQuestions.recommendation: default and sm, the visual reference's two sizes; they map to medium and small through the shared size alias.
openQuestions.answer: size = default | sm (default 32x20 track with a 16px thumb, sm 24x16 with a 12px thumb), reflected. No lg.

openQuestions.question: Is label required?
openQuestions.recommendation: Yes, like Checkbox and Input; hide-label keeps it as the accessible name.
openQuestions.answer: Yes. hide-label hides it visually and keeps it as the name.

openQuestions.question: What does required mean for a switch?
openQuestions.recommendation: Native required on the inner checkbox: valueMissing while off, invalid after blur or a submit attempt.
openQuestions.answer: Must be on to submit (native valueMissing), with the aria-hidden asterisk. Agreements still belong in a Checkbox (aiHints).

openQuestions.question: Should the switch show On/Off text or icons in the thumb?
openQuestions.recommendation: No: the thumb position and track fill carry the state, and the APG keeps the label fixed.
openQuestions.answer: No state text or icons. Added later only as a new prop, if asked for.

openQuestions.question: One thumb color, or shadcn's per-mode thumb colors?
openQuestions.recommendation: One token (color.background) for both states and modes: it passes 3:1 against both tracks in light and dark.

openQuestions.question: Does the thumb animate?
openQuestions.recommendation: Yes, a short slide with the motion tokens, removed under prefers-reduced-motion.
openQuestions.answer: Thumb transform and track color transition with switch.transition-duration and switch.transition-easing; none under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
